species.real: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance, and the joint that seems to bend backwards halfway up the leg is really the ankle, not the knee.
species.name: Flamingale

dex.text: Stands on one leg in the salt pond and judges everybody. Has been pink since breakfast and will not be told why.
dex.fact: Flamingos feed in shallow salt ponds, and their pink colour comes from carotenoid pigments in the brine shrimp and algae they eat.
